checkpoints: An edit with no current document schedules no save and performs no write.
Repeated edits restart the 120 ms quiet interval; no write occurs before the latest deadline, and expiration writes the latest exact text once.
After a burst saves, a later burst can save again; empty text is saved.
Switching, closing, or disposing while a save is pending leaves that save associated with its original document; different documents have independent tasks.
Reopening a document reuses its store-owned buffer.
A save listener may synchronously navigate; the resulting view and subscription remain authoritative.
Document rendering, status payloads, and preview behavior remain unchanged.
forbidden_effects: Writing to the store immediately on each edit.
Dropping pending document work when its badge detaches or redirecting that work to the current document.
Adding departure-triggered flushes that change the existing quiet-interval behavior.
Changing the search preview's 40 ms interval or cancellation on hide.
Allowing stale save completion effects to overwrite navigation performed synchronously by store listeners.
lifecycle_identity: BufferBank belongs to Store and retains one Trailing task per document id.
Badge represents the current view and owns its subscription; detaching removes that subscription without retiring the document buffer.
A pending save retains its original document id and exact latest text.
Workspace generation identifies navigation requests and protects against superseded opens.

ordering_barriers: Each edit replaces pending text and cancels the preceding scheduled handle before scheduling the new quiet-interval deadline.
Trailing.flush clears its handle and pending text before invoking callback-capable work, allowing reentrant edits to establish a fresh burst.
Retirement captures the old badge, clears current ownership, detaches the old subscription, and clears document output; it does not flush or cancel the buffer.
An outer open checks its generation after retirement before installing a badge.
preservation: Preserve source ids and text exactly, including empty strings.
Keep document output on open based on store.read and document clearing on retirement.
Keep status notifications restricted to the badge's document id and retain id, text, and revision payload semantics.
Keep close and dispose behavior and existing navigation generation checks.
Retain pending document buffers across switch, close, dispose, and reopen without introducing a departure persistence deadline.

Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet
interval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts
must continue to save. Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces.
The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change.

Document buffers are owned by the store BufferBank, while Badge owns only a live subscription. A store listener may call navigation synchronously. All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics.
void edit(String text){Badge view=current;if(view!=null){env.write(view.id,text);}}

static final class BufferBank {final Map<String,Trailing> entries=new HashMap<>();Trailing get(Environment env,String id){return entries.computeIfAbsent(id,k->new Trailing(env,120,text->env.write(k,text)));}}
void push(String text) { if(handle!=null)env.cancel(handle); pending=text; handle=env.schedule(this::flush,delay); }
void flush() { if(handle!=null)env.cancel(handle); String text=pending; handle=null;pending=null; if(text!=null)work.accept(text); }
void retire(){Badge old=current;current=null;if(old!=null&&!false)old.detach();env.output("document",null);if(old!=null){}if(old!=null&&false)old.detach();}
token=env.store().subscribe(e->{if(id.equals(e.get("id")))env.output("status",e);});}void detach(){env.store().stop(token);}
void query(String text){task.push(text);}void hide(){task.cancel();}
